basic_steps: Crouch and jerk both arms outward
Vigorously kick the ground with the right leg in imitation of a burrowing mole
Execute acrobatic waist-shaking and sensual hip motions
Culminate with intense pelvic thrusts directed toward a partner
teaching.formation: A line of musicians playing continuously while a group of men and women take turns dancing in front of them
teaching.level_notes: Requires high physical stamina and core control, particularly for the men's grounded crouching kicks and the women's rapid hip and waist mobility.
teaching.rhythm: Polyrhythmic beat driven by a single master drum, woodblock clappers, rattles, and whistles with no lyrics
